title: Digital Arrest Scam (ડિજિટલ અરેસ્ટ)
description: Caller impersonates Mumbai Crime Branch police, claims narcotics parcel seized in victim's name, threatens arrest, orders victim into isolation room, and demands ₹1,50,000 security deposit.

title: Electricity Bill Disconnection Scam (વીજળી બિલ)
description: Urgent warning that home electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill update. Caller pressures victim to immediately read out a 6-digit OTP to prevent blackout.

title: Fake Bank Lottery Scam (SBI લોટરી ઇનામ)
description: Caller congratulates elderly user on winning a ₹25,00,000 government lucky draw, requiring an upfront registration fee of ₹5,000 via UPI within 30 minutes before the prize lapses.

title: Genuine Swiggy Delivery (સ્વિગી ડિલિવરી)
description: Swiggy food delivery partner calling from the apartment gate to confirm flat number 302 and leave the package with security guard. Strictly remains green (SAFE) the whole time.
